component.name: BananaSplit
component.summary: Virtual audio mixer with cables, buses and a recorder

description.p: BananaSplit mixes, routes and records audio on PipeWire: 6 strips and 5 buses with EQ, virtual cables to send any app's sound where you want it, VBAN over the network and a recorder that writes MP3 or WAV.
It lives in the tray, and closing its window keeps the mixer running.
Recordings go into a folder per day; a take that runs past midnight continues in the next day's folder, and the player still lists it as one take.

Apps go back to their strip when BananaSplit starts again, so a recording no longer stays silent after an update; the recorder warns when a take records only silence; the open window needs far less CPU.
Fixes from the 2.8.2 review: the window no longer opens empty on virtual machines, software rendering or hybrid laptops, and the recording state lists only the files being written.
BananaSplit is available as a Flatpak.
